relevance_note: Cohort study of 58 genetically confirmed SSADH deficiency individuals with per-patient ALDH5A1 genotypes: 'The study included the genetic information of 58 (1:1 male/female ratio) individuals from 50 unrelated families with 32 ALDH5A1 allelic variants'.
method_note: Extraction by hand from the Markdown full text; no script was used. Table 2 is the per-patient table ('Allelic variants, zygosity, resultant proteins combination, and eventual protein impairment effect of the SSADHD patients included in the study'); its first column ('Patient') holds bare numbers 1-58, so labels follow the v4 bare-number rule and are 'Table 2 #1' ... 'Table 2 #58'; the text refers to the same people as 'patients #1, #5, #11, ...' and '(patient # 19)', the same identifiers. One further person, 'patient # 59', is described only in the text (severe clinical picture, drug-resistant seizures, an additional nonsense variant c.1234C > T); the paper states 58 participants and #59's variant combination matches Table 2 patient 55, so this is kept as a separate person (never merged) and flagged as a contradiction. Other internal contradictions: patient 37's allele 1 is printed 'c.278C > T' while C93F is attributed to c.278G > T elsewhere; the text's 'A173C substitution (c.517C > T)' vs 'R173C' in Table 1 and in patient 13's row; the text's 'G520A substitution (c.1558G > C)' vs 'G520R' in Tables 1-3 and in patients 41/56/57; 'G176E' in patients 11 and 36 vs Table 1's 'G176R'. Zygosity comes from each person's own Table 2 cell ('Homozygosis' -> homozygous, 'Compound heterozygosis' -> compound heterozygous). Consanguinity 'yes' only for the nine rows whose zygosity cell carries the asterisk defined by the legend '* Consanguinity.' (patients 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 29, 32, 33, 45). Sex, age, ethnicity and vital status are given only for the group (e.g. 'participants overall median (IQR) age at their first study visit was 9.8 (5.4-15.3) years'), so they are 'not reported' per person. The group statement 'No participant was born prematurely or had any perinatal complications' names the whole group, so those two features are recorded as excluded for the 58 cohort members with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. Table 4 counts (e.g. '30 (52%) had ataxia') name no individuals and were not used; Table 4 is a group-level table whose multi-value cells are not per-patient stacked values, so no stacked-cell assignment was needed. CSS quartile statements (mildest/most severe severity) are severity classes, not clinical features, and were not recorded as features. Variant type: 'splice' for the six cDNAs the text calls splice-site variants, 'nonsense' for patient #1's two variants and for #59's c.1234C > T; otherwise 'not reported' (Table 2's 'Truncated protein' and 'impaired splicing' describe the protein combination, not the variant class). Pathogenicity is stated only at cohort level ('the 32 allelic variants ... were pathogenic') and the SIFT/POLYPHEN-2/CUPSAT/steric-hindrance results are computational predictions, not functional assays, so pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors and functional_evidence_statement are 'not reported' for every variant (D-29). inheritance is 'not reported' for all: the paper states autosomal recessive inheritance in general but reports no parental testing and no carrier parent. is_proband is false with a null span for everyone because the paper never calls anyone a proband or index case. source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' for all: these are the study's own patients and there is no per-patient source column. protein_hgvs_as_stated is taken from the person's own Table 2 protein-combination cell where it names the protein (e.g. 'Hemizygote G268E homotetramers'), else null. Table 1 appears in the Markdown as several fragments with the reference list interleaved and was not transcribed.
